notes.title: Major Update for Just a Gigolo 1.01
notes.content: [p][b]Big Update for [i]Just a Gigolo[/i]![/b][/p][p]We’re excited to share a major update that improves the overall experience of [i]Just a Gigolo[/i]. This release focuses on enhancing visual quality and streamlining navigation, making the story more immersive and easier to enjoy.[/p][p]✨ [b]What’s new in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgraded image quality for a more polished and consistent look[/p][/*][*][p]Improved navigation for smoother progression through the Visual Novel[/p][/*][*][p]General performance and stability enhancements[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and supporting [i]Just a Gigolo[/i]! We’ll continue working to bring you the best experience possible.[/p]
